title: Add fixed planning status validation
description: Implement the fixed planning status catalog and parser for toplan, researched, planned, and rejected without mixing them into configurable execution statuses. Enforce nil startedAt/completedAt for every planning record. Implement exactly these transitions: toplan to researched or rejected; researched to toplan, planned, or rejected; planned to researched or rejected; rejected to toplan; reject same-state and every other direct move. Creation may select any planning status and defaults are handled by callers. Add table-driven parsing, lifecycle, transition, and timestamp tests, including configured execution statuses with the same leaf names remaining independent.
